category.reason: The official fine-grained box covers only a narrow strip near the right boundary of column E. The instruction specifies the column boundary over the full table height; clicking inside the column does not satisfy boundary localization.

instruction.en: The vertical line on the right side of point E is the right selection line, and the selection height covers the entire table.
instruction.zh: E 点右侧的竖线是右侧选择线，选择高度覆盖整个表格。

reference.patch: Added instruction.zh by translating the original English instruction
